svg.title: Task 202 · Preliminary Hazard Analysis worksheet
svg.desc: Spreadsheet view of Task 202 · Preliminary Hazard Analysis, generated from safety/hazards/*.yaml.
svg.text: The analyst selects a severity (1–4, by the worst credible mishap) and a
probability (A–F, by likelihood over the item's life). MIL-STD-882E Table III
maps the pair to a risk level. Both selections and the stated basis are shown for
every hazard, so a reviewer can challenge the inputs, not just the result.

21 rows · mini-grid: rows A–F probability, columns 1–4 severity; outlined cell = the selection · precedence a–e per MIL-STD-882E 4.3.4

g.text: Terms: 1A–4F = risk assessment code, severity 1–4 plus probability A–F (e.g. 1C) · 3D = three-dimensional · AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · BMS = battery management system · CF1, CF2 … = causal factor in a hazard record (CF1, CF2 …) · CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) ·

CONOPS = concept of operations · CSV = comma-separated values, a plain-text table format any spreadsheet program opens · DoD = US Department of Defense · EC-nnn = edge case found by a failure search · F-nnn = system function in the item definition · GNSS = global navigation satellite system (GPS and similar) · GPS = Global Positioning System · HAZ-nnn = hazard record

(safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · IF-PX4-nnn = PX4 integration interface (integrations/px4/interface-contract.md) · M1, M2 … = mitigation in a hazard record (M1, M2 …), or a SysML model check rule in tools/sysml · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May

2012, base edition) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · RAC = risk assessment code, severity category plus probability level (e.g. 1C) · ROLE-nnn = project role in the tailoring record (simulated until the lead says otherwise) · SCN-nnn = CONOPS scenario (SCN-0nn nominal, SCN-1nn off-nominal) · SF-nnn = walker failure-search family

(sim/search) · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-RISKDEF-001 = the project's tailored risk definitions (standards/tailoring) · SYS-nnn = system safety requirement record (requirements/SYS-nnn.yaml) · SysML = Systems Modeling Language (SysML v2) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone) · US = United States
